```{r}
############################################################

# Aim:
# Run RefSeq fungal and viral genus-level prevalence testing.

# Fungal and viral WGS data are sparse and zero-inflated.
# A taxon may not differ strongly in abundance, but may differ in
# how often it is detected. This script tests presence/absence
# differences by pregnancy outcome using Fisher's exact test.
############################################################


############################
# 1. Load packages
############################

required_packages <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "ggplot2",
  "readr",
  "stringr",
  "tibble"
)

for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)


############################
# 2. Define file paths
############################

project_root <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project"

data_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Data")
results_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Results")
figures_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Figures")

metadata_file_tsv <- file.path(data_dir, "metadata_clean.tsv")

fungal_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_fungal_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

viral_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_viral_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

results_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "RefSeq_prevalence_testing")
figures_dir <- file.path(figures_dir, "RefSeq_prevalence_testing")

dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


############################
# 3. Read metadata safely
############################


meta <- read.delim(
  metadata_file_tsv,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)


colnames(meta)[1] <- "sample_label"

# Ensure BMI is numeric for downstream compatibility, although BMI is not
# used directly in Fisher prevalence testing.

meta$bmi <- as.numeric(meta$bmi)


############################
# 4. Helper function:
# read matrix and align metadata
############################

read_and_align_refseq_matrix <- function(matrix_file, meta) {
  
  # Read matrix with sequencing IDs as rownames.
  # Rows = samples, columns = taxa.
  
  mat <- read.delim(
    matrix_file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # Remove possible trailing "_1" from matrix sample IDs.
  matrix_ids_clean <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(mat))
  
  # Mandatory safety check: unmatched samples.
  unmatched <- setdiff(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID)
  
  if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Unmatched samples found:",
        paste(unmatched, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }
  
  # Match metadata using reads_ID only.
  meta_aligned <- meta[
    match(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID),
  ]
  
  # Mandatory safety check: exact order.
  if (!all(meta_aligned$reads_ID == matrix_ids_clean)) {
    stop("Metadata order mismatch")
  }
  
  # Explicitly set matrix rownames to cleaned sequencing IDs.
  rownames(mat) <- matrix_ids_clean
  
  return(
    list(
      mat = mat,
      meta = meta_aligned
    )
  )
}


############################
# 5. Helper function:
# Fisher prevalence testing
############################

run_prevalence_tests <- function(mat, meta, outcome_var, dataset_name) {
  
  if (!outcome_var %in% colnames(meta)) {
    stop(paste("Outcome variable not found in metadata:", outcome_var))
  }
  
  # Keep samples with non-missing outcome.
  keep_samples <- !is.na(meta[[outcome_var]]) & meta[[outcome_var]] != ""
  
  mat_sub <- mat[keep_samples, , drop = FALSE]
  meta_sub <- meta[keep_samples, , drop = FALSE]
  
  group <- as.factor(meta_sub[[outcome_var]])
  
  # Fisher's exact test is for two-group comparison.
  if (length(levels(group)) != 2) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Outcome variable must have exactly two groups:",
        outcome_var,
        "has",
        length(levels(group)),
        "groups"
      )
    )
  }
  
  group_levels <- levels(group)
  group_1 <- group_levels[1]
  group_2 <- group_levels[2]
  
  results_list <- list()
  
  for (taxon in colnames(mat_sub)) {
    
    abundance <- mat_sub[[taxon]]
    
    # Convert abundance to presence/absence.
    # Present = abundance > 0
    # Absent = abundance == 0
    
    presence <- ifelse(abundance > 0, 1, 0)
    
    test_df <- data.frame(
      group = group,
      presence = presence
    )
    
    contingency_table <- table(test_df$group, test_df$presence)
    
    # Ensure both absence and presence columns exist.
    if (!"0" %in% colnames(contingency_table)) {
      contingency_table <- cbind(contingency_table, "0" = 0)
    }
    
    if (!"1" %in% colnames(contingency_table)) {
      contingency_table <- cbind(contingency_table, "1" = 0)
    }
    
    contingency_table <- contingency_table[, c("0", "1"), drop = FALSE]
    
    fisher_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    
    n_group_1 <- sum(group == group_1)
    n_group_2 <- sum(group == group_2)
    
    present_group_1 <- sum(presence[group == group_1] == 1)
    present_group_2 <- sum(presence[group == group_2] == 1)
    
    prevalence_group_1 <- present_group_1 / n_group_1
    prevalence_group_2 <- present_group_2 / n_group_2
    
    prevalence_difference <- prevalence_group_2 - prevalence_group_1
    
    enriched_group <- case_when(
      prevalence_difference > 0 ~ group_2,
      prevalence_difference < 0 ~ group_1,
      TRUE ~ "No difference"
    )
    
    results_list[[taxon]] <- data.frame(
      dataset = dataset_name,
      outcome = outcome_var,
      taxon = taxon,
      group_1 = group_1,
      group_2 = group_2,
      n_group_1 = n_group_1,
      n_group_2 = n_group_2,
      present_group_1 = present_group_1,
      present_group_2 = present_group_2,
      prevalence_group_1 = prevalence_group_1,
      prevalence_group_2 = prevalence_group_2,
      prevalence_difference_group2_minus_group1 = prevalence_difference,
      enriched_group = enriched_group,
      odds_ratio = unname(fisher_result$estimate),
      p_value = fisher_result$p.value
    )
  }
  
  results <- bind_rows(results_list)
  
  # Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction is applied separately for each:
  # dataset + outcome comparison.
  
  results <- results %>%
    mutate(
      q_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      nominal_signal = p_value < 0.05,
      fdr_significant = q_value < 0.05
    ) %>%
    arrange(q_value, p_value)
  
  return(results)
}


############################
# 6. Read and align RefSeq datasets
############################

fungal_aligned <- read_and_align_refseq_matrix(
  matrix_file = fungal_file,
  meta = meta
)

viral_aligned <- read_and_align_refseq_matrix(
  matrix_file = viral_file,
  meta = meta
)

fungal_mat <- fungal_aligned$mat
fungal_meta <- fungal_aligned$meta

viral_mat <- viral_aligned$mat
viral_meta <- viral_aligned$meta


############################
# 7. Run prevalence testing
############################

# Primary comparison:
# TERM vs sPTB

fungal_outcome_results <- run_prevalence_tests(
  mat = fungal_mat,
  meta = fungal_meta,
  outcome_var = "outcome",
  dataset_name = "RefSeq fungi"
)

viral_outcome_results <- run_prevalence_tests(
  mat = viral_mat,
  meta = viral_meta,
  outcome_var = "outcome",
  dataset_name = "RefSeq viruses"
)

# Secondary comparison:
# sPTB34 yes/no

fungal_sptb34_results <- run_prevalence_tests(
  mat = fungal_mat,
  meta = fungal_meta,
  outcome_var = "sPTB34",
  dataset_name = "RefSeq fungi"
)

viral_sptb34_results <- run_prevalence_tests(
  mat = viral_mat,
  meta = viral_meta,
  outcome_var = "sPTB34",
  dataset_name = "RefSeq viruses"
)


############################
# 8. Combine and save results
############################

all_prevalence_results <- bind_rows(
  fungal_outcome_results,
  fungal_sptb34_results,
  viral_outcome_results,
  viral_sptb34_results
)

write_csv(
  fungal_outcome_results,
  file.path(results_dir, "refseq_fungal_prevalence_TERM_vs_sPTB.csv")
)

write_csv(
  fungal_sptb34_results,
  file.path(results_dir, "refseq_fungal_prevalence_sPTB34_yes_no.csv")
)

write_csv(
  viral_outcome_results,
  file.path(results_dir, "refseq_viral_prevalence_TERM_vs_sPTB.csv")
)

write_csv(
  viral_sptb34_results,
  file.path(results_dir, "refseq_viral_prevalence_sPTB34_yes_no.csv")
)

write_csv(
  all_prevalence_results,
  file.path(results_dir, "refseq_all_prevalence_results.csv")
)


############################
# 9. Create summary table
############################

prevalence_summary <- all_prevalence_results %>%
  group_by(dataset, outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    n_taxa_tested = n(),
    n_nominal_p_lt_0p05 = sum(nominal_signal, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_fdr_q_lt_0p05 = sum(fdr_significant, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_p_value = min(p_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_q_value = min(q_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  prevalence_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "refseq_prevalence_testing_summary.csv")
)

print(prevalence_summary)


############################
# 10. Save nominal hits
############################

nominal_hits <- all_prevalence_results %>%
  filter(nominal_signal == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(dataset, outcome, p_value)

write_csv(
  nominal_hits,
  file.path(results_dir, "refseq_prevalence_nominal_hits_p_lt_0p05.csv")
)

fdr_hits <- all_prevalence_results %>%
  filter(fdr_significant == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(dataset, outcome, q_value)

write_csv(
  fdr_hits,
  file.path(results_dir, "refseq_prevalence_fdr_hits_q_lt_0p05.csv")
)


############################
# 11. Plot top prevalence signals
############################

plot_top_prevalence <- function(results, output_filename, top_n = 15) {
  
  plot_df <- results %>%
    arrange(p_value) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    mutate(
      taxon = factor(taxon, levels = rev(unique(taxon))),
      comparison = paste(group_1, "vs", group_2)
    ) %>%
    select(
      dataset,
      outcome,
      taxon,
      group_1,
      group_2,
      prevalence_group_1,
      prevalence_group_2
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(prevalence_group_1, prevalence_group_2),
      names_to = "group_type",
      values_to = "prevalence"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      group = case_when(
        group_type == "prevalence_group_1" ~ group_1,
        group_type == "prevalence_group_2" ~ group_2
      )
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = taxon,
      y = prevalence,
      fill = group
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      limits = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Top prevalence signals: ", unique(results$dataset), " / ", unique(results$outcome)),
      x = "Taxon",
      y = "Prevalence",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(figures_dir, output_filename),
    plot = p,
    width = 9,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}

plot_top_prevalence(
  fungal_outcome_results,
  "refseq_fungal_prevalence_TERM_vs_sPTB_top_signals.png"
)

plot_top_prevalence(
  fungal_sptb34_results,
  "refseq_fungal_prevalence_sPTB34_yes_no_top_signals.png"
)

plot_top_prevalence(
  viral_outcome_results,
  "refseq_viral_prevalence_TERM_vs_sPTB_top_signals.png"
)

plot_top_prevalence(
  viral_sptb34_results,
  "refseq_viral_prevalence_sPTB34_yes_no_top_signals.png"
)


############################
# 12. Interpretation helper table
############################

interpretation_table <- all_prevalence_results %>%
  mutate(
    interpretation = case_when(
      fdr_significant ~ "FDR-significant prevalence difference",
      nominal_signal ~ "Nominal prevalence signal only; exploratory",
      TRUE ~ "No prevalence signal"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    dataset,
    outcome,
    taxon,
    group_1,
    group_2,
    prevalence_group_1,
    prevalence_group_2,
    prevalence_difference_group2_minus_group1,
    enriched_group,
    odds_ratio,
    p_value,
    q_value,
    interpretation
  ) %>%
  arrange(dataset, outcome, q_value, p_value)

write_csv(
  interpretation_table,
  file.path(results_dir, "refseq_prevalence_interpretation_table.csv")
)


############################
# 13. Final message
############################

message("Complete: RefSeq fungal and viral prevalence testing finished.")
message("Results saved to: ", results_dir)
message("Figures saved to: ", figures_dir)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Plot RefSeq prevalence-testing nominal candidate taxa
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
})

# ============================================================
# Set paths
# ============================================================

results_dir <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project/Results/RefSeq_prevalence_testing"

out_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# Read prevalence results
# ============================================================

df <- read_csv(
  file.path(results_dir, "refseq_all_prevalence_results.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# Keep nominal prevalence signals only
# ============================================================

plot_df <- df %>%
  filter(p_value < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    domain = case_when(
      str_detect(dataset, "fungi") ~ "Fungal",
      str_detect(dataset, "viruses") ~ "Viral",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    
    comparison_label = case_when(
      outcome == "outcome" ~ "TERM vs sPTB",
      outcome == "sPTB34" ~ "sPTB34 yes vs no",
      TRUE ~ outcome
    ),
    
    enriched_label = case_when(
      enriched_group == "TERM" ~ "TERM",
      enriched_group == "sPTB" ~ "sPTB",
      enriched_group == "yes" ~ "sPTB <34",
      enriched_group == "no" ~ "Not sPTB <34",
      TRUE ~ enriched_group
    ),
    
    effect = prevalence_difference_group2_minus_group1,
    neg_log10_p = -log10(p_value),
    taxon_label = taxon
  ) %>%
  arrange(domain, comparison_label, p_value) %>%
  group_by(domain, comparison_label) %>%
  mutate(
    taxon_label = factor(
      taxon_label,
      levels = rev(unique(taxon_label))
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================================
# Safety check
# ============================================================

if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
  stop("No nominal prevalence signals with p < 0.05 to plot.")
}

message("Number of nominal prevalence signals plotted: ", nrow(plot_df))
message("Number of unique taxa plotted: ", length(unique(plot_df$taxon)))

# ============================================================
# Plot
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = effect,
    y = taxon_label,
    size = neg_log10_p,
    colour = enriched_label
  )
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_grid(
    domain ~ comparison_label,
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y"
  ) +
 scale_colour_manual(
  values = c(
    "TERM" = "#1f77b4",
    "sPTB" = "#CC79A7",
    "sPTB <34" = "#E69F00",
    "Not sPTB <34" = "#009E73"
    )
) +
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence-testing nominal signals",
    x = "Prevalence difference between groups",
    y = NULL,
    size = "-log10(p-value)",
    colour = "Higher prevalence in"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = "black"
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# ============================================================
# Save outputs
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "refseq_prevalence_nominal_signals_overview_corrected_colours.png"
  ),
  plot = p,
  width = 11,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    out_dir,
    "refseq_prevalence_nominal_signals_overview_corrected_colours.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p,
  width = 11,
  height = 9
)

message("Figure saved to: ", out_dir)
```
